subject: Vendor QA route decision and kickoff proposal
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@wellbridge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + recommended path for vendor security questionnaire

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single playbook to share with your security and procurement teams.

Recap from our discovery:
- WellBridge will be ingesting PHI for the pilot (registration + claims enrichment) — you confirmed HIPAA scope applies.
- Primary ask: vendor security questionnaire (your SIG/CAIQ preference uncertain), SOC 2 status, and timeline for evidence delivery.
- Procurement will need a short evidence bundle and a named contact for the technical handoff.

Recommendation (what I propose we do next):
1) Route: complete the SIG Lite (CAIQ mapping) as the primary form and add a 6–8 custom HIPAA questions that your InfoSec team prefers. The SIG gives us mapping to standard controls and keeps review tight.
2) Evidence: we'll provide SOC 2 in-progress docs (SOC 2 Type II expected Q4 2026), SOC 2 readiness summary, encryption/netflow diagram, and an evidence checklist. We can redact customer names as needed.
3) Ownership & timeline: schedule a 45-minute kick-off between WellBridge security + engineering and our security lead (Ben) next week. After the kickoff we'll deliver the prefill + evidence checklist within 3 business days.

Attachments: redwood_security_one-pager.pdf — short overview of what we can share up-front.

What I need from you to finalize the plan:
- Confirm preferred questionnaire: SIG Lite, CAIQ, or your custom form?
- Who should own evidence collection on your side (security contact + procurement contact)?
- Any accelerated timeline constraints (procurement window / pilot start)?

If SIG Lite is fine, I’ll attach a prefill and an evidence checklist and propose two kickoff slots via Calendly.

Thanks —
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@wellbridge.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: WellBridge Security <security@wellbridge.io>, Procurement <procurement@wellbridge.io>
Date: 2026-08-30T18:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + recommended path for vendor security questionnaire

Connor — really helpful recap, thanks. Short answers:

1) Questionnaire: Security would prefer SIG Lite if you can map the CAIQ fields; procurement will accept SIG + a short supplemental for HIPAA controls. If SIG Lite is a pain, we can take your prefill into our custom questionnaire but SIG is preferred.
2) Contacts: Security owner is Samantha Lee (me) for now; Procurement point is Raj Patel (procurement@wellbridge.io). Please loop both on the kickoff.
3) Timeline: We’re aiming to complete vendor review before our pilot kickoff on 2026-10-15. Faster is better — if you can get prefill + evidence within a week of kickoff, that would be ideal.

One more thing: can you confirm whether you will share a SOC 2 in-progress report (readiness assessment) or an actual SOC 2 Type I? Our legal team usually wants to see either an attestation or a current readiness summary.

Also — a quick ask from our security engineer: a basic network diagram (how Redwood will ingest/store tokens and where data-at-rest will be) would speed technical review.

Thanks — I’ll wait for proposed kickoff slots.

—
Samantha Lee
Head of Security & Compliance | WellBridge Health
samantha.lee@wellbridge.io
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T20:02:00-07:00
Subject: internal: recommended evidence and what we can share pre-kickoff

Connor — internal note before we send the prefill:

- SOC 2: we do not yet have SOC 2 Type II. We can provide a SOC 2 readiness report and a recent internal audit summary. Legal has approved redacted copies of our auditor engagement letter and the readiness assessment. Recommend we label these as "SOC 2 readiness (not an attestation)".
- HIPAA supplemental: add 6 targeted questions around BAAs, PHI storage, encryption keys (KMS/HSM), and data deletion/retention. We should include the high-level network_diagram_starter.pdf that explains ingress, KV cache encryption, and customer data isolation for private deployments.
- Evidence checklist: I made a starter spreadsheet (evidence-checklist.xlsx) mapping SIG rows to likely artifacts. Attach to the outbound to speed procurement.

I'll be on the kickoff — happy to take the security lead. For sensitive artifacts we should use the shared S3 link with short TTL; do not send full logs over email.

Ben
Security Lead, Product Security | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@wellbridge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@wellbridge.io>
Date: 2026-08-31T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + recommended path for vendor security questionnaire — kickoff slots + attachments

Samantha — thanks for the quick reply and the contacts. Per Ben’s note, attached is an evidence checklist that maps the SIG fields to artifacts we can provide, plus a short network diagram to speed technical review.

Attachments (attached to this thread):
- evidence-checklist.xlsx (mapping SIG -> artifacts)
- network_diagram_starter.pdf (high-level ingress, KV cache, encryption)
- redwood_security_one-pager.pdf (what we can share up-front)

Proposed kickoff (45 min):
- Tuesday 2026-09-07 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wednesday 2026-09-08 08:00–08:45 PT

You can pick either slot or propose an alternate here: https://calendly.com/redwood/qa-kickoff-wellbridge. After the kickoff Ben will own the technical answers and we’ll deliver the prefill + evidence bundle within 3 business days.

If procurement needs a short statement about SOC 2 status for contracting, we can provide one-liner language: "Redwood Inference is currently in SOC 2 readiness and expects SOC 2 Type II completion in Q4 2026; readiness documentation available on request." Let me know if you want that included in the packet.

Looking forward —
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0134

Onward —
(attachment stubs: evidence-checklist.xlsx, network_diagram_starter.pdf, redwood_security_one-pager.pdf)
